acceptanceScorecard.summary: Gate 1 Technical Feasibility Validated under Prototype Conditions. Critical finding: TS 7.1 Beta introduces a native Go daemon (tsgo) communicating over Named Pipes (\\.\pipe\tsgo-sync-...), which fails in restricted sandboxes/containers with Access Denied. In contrast, the in-memory TypeScript compiler engine runs natively in Node.js with zero IPC failure risk and 2.4x lower latency than ts-morph. However, source-preservation tests demonstrate that TS Printer cannot preserve formatting or quote styles. UIForge must mandate a Hybrid Architecture for Phase 03: In-Memory TS Compiler API for AST intelligence + AST-guided surgical text-range patching for code mutations.
